title: Responsibility Claim
description: An identity, acting through an authorized key, publicly accepts one or more defined responsibilities for a subject.

@context.description: Optional JSON-LD context URI for semantic processing.

attester.title: Attester ID
attester.description: DID or address of the key making this attestation. The attester is expected to be an authorized key for the responsibleParty, verifiable via Key Binding and/or Controller Witness.

responsibleParty.title: Responsible Party ID
responsibleParty.description: DID of the organization or identity publicly accepting responsibility. The attester must be an authorized key for this identity.

subject.title: Subject ID
subject.description: DID of the resource, service, application, agent, product, or artifact for which responsibility is being claimed.

responsibilityType.title: Responsibility Type
responsibilityType.description: The complete current set of responsibilities the responsible party accepts for the subject. If responsibilities change, revoke this attestation and publish a replacement with a new array. Partial revocation of individual types is not supported.

x-oma3-enum.label: Creator
x-oma3-enum.description: Original author or maker of the subject. Asserts authorship of the resource.

x-oma3-enum.label: Distributor
x-oma3-enum.description: Responsible for delivering or distributing the subject through a channel. Covers publishing, mirroring, packaging, app store distribution, and CDN hosting.

x-oma3-enum.label: Maintainer
x-oma3-enum.description: Actively maintains the subject. Implies ongoing responsibility for updates, patches, and security fixes.

revoked.title: Revoked
revoked.description: Indicates if this responsibility claim has been revoked.

revokedAt.title: Revocation Date
revokedAt.description: Time the responsibility claim was revoked.

proofs.title: Proofs
proofs.description: Optional proofs supporting this responsibility claim. In most cases, the attester's authorization is verified separately via Key Binding and Controller Witness. Reserved for future proof types that may directly evidence a responsibility relationship.

issuedAt.title: Issued Date
issuedAt.description: Time the responsibility claim was issued. Default is current time.

effectiveAt.title: Effective Date
effectiveAt.description: Time the responsibility claim becomes effective. Default is current time.

expiresAt.title: Expiration Date
expiresAt.description: Time the responsibility claim expires. Default is no expiration.
